featured_reviews.name: Rajath Nanaiah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ghodbunder Estuary, located in Maharashtra, India, is a hidden gem for nature enthusiasts and those seeking tranquility away from the bustling city life. Nestled at the confluence of the Ulhas River and the Arabian Sea, the estuary offers a serene escape with its picturesque views and rich biodiversity.

The estuary is renowned for its mangrove forests, which play a crucial role in maintaining the ecological balance and providing habitat for various bird species. Bird watchers will find it particularly rewarding, as the area is frequented by a variety of migratory and resident birds. The peaceful waters and lush surroundings also make it an ideal spot for boat rides, allowing visitors to soak in the natural beauty and observe the vibrant flora and fauna up close.

For those interested in history, the nearby Ghodbunder Fort adds a historical dimension to the visit. This fort, dating back to the 13th century, offers panoramic views of the estuary and is a testament to the region’s rich heritage.

While the Ghodbunder Estuary is relatively less commercialized, which is part of its charm, it’s advisable to visit with a guide or local expert to fully appreciate its ecological and historical significance. Overall, Ghodbunder Estuary is a captivating destination for anyone looking to experience the beauty of nature and the tranquility of a less-traveled spot.

featured_reviews.name: Umesh Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
The statue of Chimaji Appa near Dongri Fort in Uttan was built by the Mira-Bhayandar Municipal Corporation in 2022 to honor a brave Maratha warrior. Chimaji Appa was the younger brother of Peshwa Bajirao I, and he is famous for winning the Vasai Fort from the Portuguese in 1739. During this mission, Dongri Fort was an important place that helped the Maratha army. Today, his statue stands near the fort, facing the sea, and is surrounded by a beautiful garden where people can relax and enjoy nature.
The area is part of a lively fishing village where the Koli community lives, adding a local cultural touch. Nearby, visitors can also explore quiet beaches, old churches, and small guesthouses. This place is becoming popular for tourists who love history, nature, and peaceful surroundings. Local people are working to protect this heritage and promote respectful tourism.

featured_reviews.name: WinNie
featured_reviews.review_text: The church has lot of information online. Little information is at the church itself. The church was primarily the initiative of a local individual, Mr. Francis Correa, around thirty years prior to 2022 (meaning around the 1990s). The church was built to replicate the famous Our Lady of Good Health Basilica in Velankanni, Tamil Nadu, bringing that specific Marian devotion to the Uttan coast. The church celebrates its main festival from August 29 to September 8 each year, culminating on the Feast of the Nativity of Mary, a tradition mirroring the original Tamil Nadu Basilica. The church is spread over a large area and its location is correct on the maps. The parking is ample and there is no fee. The church is open through the afternoon and was very beautiful. Most of the sitting arena is donated inside the church. It has garden and several statues around next to the road. You can walk around admiring th beauty of the statues. There is a white statue, nearby, which has a old natural well. Of course it is covered now, and access is not possible. The route to the church can get smelly view drying fish, which is one of the source of income. The church and nearby upliftment has been undertaken in the recent past and is not old. It is because of the interest of a particular father, who was incharge of the church. If you drive from the church you can reach gorai beach in less than 10 minutes. The lighthouse resort is just next to the church. There is a water filter behind the church, you can drink this water safely. There are enough food and juice carts around the church. Try avoiding plastic glasses, so insist on steel or material like glass or carry your own. If you have trash, please dispose it in garbage bin.

featured_reviews.name: Ayan Sarang
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beautiful place
The Velankanni Uttan Shrine Church, located in Uttan near Bhayandar, Maharashtra, is a revered pilgrimage destination for thousands of devotees from across India. Dedicated to Our Lady of Velankanni, also known as the "Lady of Good Health," this coastal shrine is enveloped in an atmosphere of peace and spirituality. Pilgrims, especially from the nearby city of Mumbai, flock to this church seeking blessings, healing, and comfort.

What sets this church apart is its stunning location on the coast, offering visitors a serene and scenic environment to reflect and pray. The architecture of the shrine reflects a blend of traditional and modern elements, with its high vaulted ceilings, stained glass windows, and a beautifully adorned altar that captivates worshippers. The interiors are simple yet elegant, focusing on providing a sacred space for meditation and devotion.

One of the highlights of the Velankanni Uttan Shrine is its annual feast in September, a time when the church grounds come alive with vibrant decorations, processions, and devotional music. During this period, the church is filled with an overwhelming sense of unity and community, as people from diverse backgrounds come together to celebrate their faith. The church also offers daily Masses and prayer services, making it an ideal place for spiritual rejuvenation.

In addition to its religious significance, the Velankanni Uttan Shrine Church is also a popular spot for tourists who appreciate its tranquil setting and panoramic views of the Arabian Sea. The church’s commitment to charity and social work further enhances its role as a beacon of hope for those in need. Velankanni Uttan Shrine is, undoubtedly, a place where faith, community, and natural beauty converge, making it a cherished landmark for both worship and retreat.

featured_reviews.review_text:
An Unforgettable 24-Day Safari & Culture Journey Through India – With Raj and Wanderlust Travel Hub

From the moment we first connected with Raj from Wanderlust Travel Hub, we knew we were in the best hands. A dear mutual friend referred us to him, and after more than a year of thoughtful planning and communication, our dream of exploring India came to life in the most personal, heartfelt, and beautifully organized way imaginable.

This was our very first visit to India — a place we had always dreamed of — and what Raj created for us will stay in our hearts forever. From the start on November 7th in Delhi, we began our journey to Jim Corbett National Park, where luck was on our side — a magnificent tiger appeared beside the road just minutes before reaching our lodge! Over the next 24 days, we traveled through some of India’s most iconic national parks and cultural treasures, each day full of wonder:

- Jim Corbett and the rare Great Hornbill sightings
- The Taj Mahal and city of Agra with our a knowledgeable local guide
- Keoladeo National Park with its spectacular birdlife
- Ranthambore with its stunning fort and amazing wildlife
- Chambal Gharial Sanctuary — spotting the critically endangered gharial crocodiles
- Jaipur’s charm, history, shopping and great local streetfood
- Visits to Tadoba, Pench, Kanha, and Bandhavgarh — we had 20 safaris in total on our tour, spotting tigers, wild dogs, sloth bears, countless birds, and the endless beauty of India’s wilderness
- Our final days brought us to Khajuraho’s mesmerizing temples and the tastiest aloo chaat street food we’ve ever had! A spontaneous stop Gwalior to see the awe-inspiring Gopachal Jain Statues and Gwalior Fort was the perfect way to close this magical journey before returning to Delhi.

None of this would have been the same without Raj. Beyond being a phenomenal tour organizer, he became a true friend — someone whose warmth, humor, and genuine care turned every day into a joy. His daily surprises with local food, his stories, and his kind guidance made us experience India not as visitors but as family.

A special mention also goes to our wonderful driver, Shubhram, whose calmness, skill, and friendly presence made long journeys smooth and safe.

If you are planning to visit India — especially for your first time — we cannot recommend Wanderlust Travel Hub highly enough. Raj creates journeys that are not just well-organized and safe, but deeply personal. Every lodge, guide, and experience feels handpicked with love and authenticity.

We will carry India — and Raj — in our hearts forever.

featured_reviews.name: Yatra Sole Traveller
featured_reviews.review_text:
A big thank you to Uthanji and his entire team for making our girls' Europe trip such a wonderful experience. From the planning stage to the end of the trip, they were always available to answer our countless pre-booking questions and guide us patiently.

Everything was well organized, including hotels, transfers, sightseeing, and local recommendations, allowing us to enjoy the trip without any stress. We created beautiful memories, explored amazing places, and had an unforgettable time together.

Thank you for your continuous support, attention to detail, and excellent service. We truly appreciate all the effort that went into making this trip so special!

featured_reviews.name: Kaushik Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an amazing experience with this Malaysia holiday package. Everything was well-organized from start to finish, making our trip completely stress-free.
The hotel arrangements were comfortable and conveniently located, and all transfers were smooth and on time. The local guides were friendly, knowledgeable, and very supportive throughout the trip, which made the experience even more enjoyable.
Overall, it was excellent value for money and truly a memorable holiday. I would highly recommend Sherul holidays to anyone planning a trip to Malaysia and would definitely choose this service again for future vacations.

featured_reviews.name: Reshma Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you, Sherul Holidays, for organising such a fantastic trip to Phuket and Krabi from 22nd–26th January. Everything was perfectly planned, and we truly enjoyed a smooth, comfortable, and memorable vacation. The hotels, transfers, and sightseeing were well coordinated, and your team was always helpful and responsive. Really appreciate the effort—looking forward to planning our next trip with you!

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Bhat
featured_reviews.review_text: We booked a Bangkok, Pattaya and Phuket tour with Sherul holidays for a group of 14 family members. Everything was meticulously planned. From pick up at the airport to daily sight seeing everything was informed a day prior by their representatives there who took really good care of us and the kids. The icing on the cake was Indian meal provided by Sherul. We all enjoyed the tour a lot and looking forward to book more such international tours with Mr.Uttan. and plus he was just one whatsaap message away from us .Thanks a lot for the lovely memories😃🙏

featured_reviews.name: sridhar lokanath
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sherul Holiday's

I recently had the pleasure of booking a trip with Sherul Holidays, Malaysia and Thailand 5 nights package and I must say, it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. Mr. Poojary demonstrated professionalism and a deep understanding of my travel preferences, ensuring every detail was meticulously planned.

The itinerary was thoughtfully curated, offering a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Accommodations were comfortable and well-located, providing easy access to key attractions. Transportation arrangements were seamless, allowing me to enjoy the journey without any concerns.

What truly set Sherul Holidays apart was their commitment to personalized service. They were attentive to my needs and preferences, making adjustments as necessary to enhance my experience. Their dedication to customer satisfaction was evident throughout the trip.

I highly recommend Sherul Holidays to anyone seeking a well-organized and memorable travel experience. Their expertise and customer-centric approach ensure a journey that exceeds expectations.

Sridhar
Bangalore
